title: Addressing the Translation coordinator
description: How to write for a reader acting as Translation coordinator. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `translation-coordinator` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Pipeline-shaped: state per locale, what moved, what is waiting
rules.description: Pipeline-shaped: state per locale, what moved, what is waiting. Never imply a translation is current when its source changed.

source.quote: Runs the translation cycle without necessarily speaking the target languages. Tracks what is extracted, sent, returned and signed off — and what has gone stale since.
